title: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, in addition to the use of the…
description: A vulnerability exists in DNSdist when DNS over HTTPS (DoH) is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, combined with the proxy protocol enabled between DNSdist and its backend. This can cause an outgoing TCP connection to be incorrectly reused for queries with different X-Forwarded-For headers, leading the backend to misattribute queries as coming from the same remote client.
